create_options_config: create an Options dataclass to configure text and image generation parameters like temperature, top_p, and guidance scale
build_token_manager: build a TokenManager to tokenize text, images, and base64 images into token IDs for the Chameleon model
generate_text_or_image: generate text or image tokens by calling ChameleonInferenceModel.generate with a prompt text or UI inputs
stream_tokens: stream generated tokens one at a time using ChameleonInferenceModel.stream with prompt text or batch inputs
decode_generated_tokens: decode generated token IDs back to text strings or PIL images using ChameleonInferenceModel.decode_text or decode_image
